incident.description: FinOps is finalizing the August 1 SaaS renewal and noticed our seat counts still look like they cover the Meridian unit we spun off last quarter. The example they raised: we appear to still be paying for a Zoom Pro seat under j.calloway@halcyondynamics.com. Please square this away - reclaim the seats that are genuinely no longer needed, and get to the bottom of how they slipped through at cutover.
incident.short_description: Meridian renewal true-up - seats we may no longer need
